question: Where are a restaurant located within a 140 kilometers radius to the south of Red Wolf Sanctuary, Rising Sun, IN?
sql: WITH sanctuary_location AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Red Wolf Sanctuary%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Rising Sun%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IN%' LIMIT 1 ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p, sanctuary_location AS sl WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, sl.geometry::geography, 140000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(sl.geometry, p.geometry)) BETWEEN 157.5 AND 202.5;
